title: Click It!
description: A review activity for grades 1–6. Follow these simple steps to use it with your class.
steps: Open Click It! and find its editing or question-entry area.
Type your words or questions; add picture choices if available.
Check which answer is correct for each item.
Choose the mode. If you choose a timed mode, set the time and press Start Timer when ready.
Ask students to tap the correct option; use the game’s score display to review results.

buttons.name: Start Timer
buttons.meaning: Begin the countdown in timed mode.

buttons.name: Picture choice
buttons.meaning: Add or choose an image answer if the editor supports it.

sections.heading: 💾 How to export, import, or load your game data
steps: Finish editing the words, questions, answers, or pictures first.
Look in the game’s setup, editor, or settings for Export JSON / Export Data / Save File. If you see one, click it to download your work as a .json file.
Keep the downloaded file in a safe place, such as a folder named after the class. Export again after making new changes.
To use the same content later, open this SAME game and choose Import JSON / Load JSON / Load Data (whichever appears).
Select the .json file you exported from this game. Check the imported words, question order, and pictures before pressing Start.
Do not use a guide JSON file from the website’s guides folder as a game-data file. They serve different purposes.

tips: The instruction JSON file in the website guides folder is NOT the same as the game-data JSON file you export.
A browser may remember changes on one device, but do not rely on that as your only backup. Export after editing whenever the game offers it.
Button labels and available editing features can differ between games. If your game does not show an export/import button, that feature has not been confirmed for that game.
